01 — About

Dontae
Amare

Fort Worth native. South Side raised. Dontae Amare makes hip-hop that doesn't apologize for having something to say. The music pulls from faith, family, and the weight of purpose — records that earn their place in your rotation because they tell the truth.

"Purpose doesn't wait for perfect conditions.
Neither does the music."

The DARE Philosophy

Every song, every game, every garment — it all points back to the same principle. Desired Ambitions Requires Execution. Not a slogan. A standard.

Dontae Amare built the music around that standard. The rest of the DARE ecosystem follows from it.

04 — Book

Divine Axioms
& Maxims

Written with Samiya Daniel, Divine Axioms & Maxims: Wisdom For A Modern Age is a collection of truth distilled into principle — an extension of the same faith and purpose that drives the music. Timeless wisdom for those navigating their calling, their gifts, and the weight of purpose.
